Researchers working on senolytics, like Judith Campisi are hopeful that with the right ones, even in the right combination, at the right dose, without side effects, we might see improved healthspan through some alleviation of age related dysfunction/disease. Isn't fisetin trials all about getting the FDA to accept age reversal therapies?
Reasons to hope to see the age of 100 and beyond: Biomedical rejuvenation through damage repair, manipulation of metabolism, beyond the mere results of exercise, caloric restriction, and fasting.
